invariants.rule: L3 WITNESS_FOUND is the only source of a new certified backup bundle.
Partial, UNKNOWN, absent, or timed-out witnesses cannot create a bundle.
The certificate bundle is immutable after creation.
Runtime cursor, status, and revision are separate from the immutable bundle.
A PREPARED_UNCOMMITTED token is not executable.
At most one retained token is ACTIVE.
Activation requires exact source candidate commit identity.
Activation cycle equals source commit cycle plus one.
Exact state and time alignment are required.
Geometry authority must match.
Actuator authority must match.
Map authority must match.
Dynamics and timebase authority must match.
An invalid token cannot self-revalidate.
A consumed control cannot execute twice.
Cursor cannot advance without successful exact commit.
A retained backup action is not an alternative source.
Retained-tail certificate reuse is allowed only under token validity PASS.
No value-changing transform is allowed before execution.
The old valid backup remains until atomic new-token activation.
A successful handoff has no observable NONE gap.
Tail exhaustion does not automatically authorize terminal action.
Deadline expiry forbids discovery but not consumption of a valid retained backup.
Historical V1 backup evidence cannot become V2 runtime token authority.
